scoring_justification: The verifier cannot rerun the heavy VMC simulations; it compares the agent's reported results against paper-derived gold patterns and tolerances (T0).

hidden_assets.purpose: Phase boundary gold values (Vp/tb1 = 1.3 and 1.7, tolerance 0.1)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 4 and textual description in Sec. 3.2: PCOI for Vp/tb1 ≲ 1.3, DMI for 1.4 ≲ Vp/tb1 ≲ 1.6, PCOI' for Vp/tb1 ≳ 1.7
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper figure and converted to numeric thresholds consistent with reference solution.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly taken from the paper's reported transition points; the reference solution writes these exact values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Structure factor pattern thresholds (high > 0.5, low < 0.2) for each insulating phase
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Sec. 3.1 and figures 6,7,10: polar phases show Bragg peak in N_CD, nonpolar in N, DMI no peak.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Convert qualitative peak presence/absence to numeric threshold checks.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The thresholds capture the paper's distinction between charge-order phases; the reference solution's values satisfy the pattern.

hidden_assets.purpose: Rich/poor sublattice indices and density thresholds for the 12-sublattice COM
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Sec. 3.3 and Fig. 14: honeycomb-like charge order with rich-rich-poor sequence; reference solution produces a representative pattern.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's description of the 12-sublattice pattern; thresholds (rich >1.5, poor <1.0) are generous to accommodate implementation spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The pattern is a structural property of the COM phase; thresholds verify that the expected charge disproportionation exists.

outputs.description: Phase boundaries in units of Vp/tb1 for the transition from PCOI to DMI and from DMI to PCOI' along the line Vp+Vq=3tb1. Optionally includes NPCOI_region boolean.
Charge structure factors N(q) and N_CD(q) at q=(0,0) and q=(π,π) for each insulating phase. The pattern of peaks is used to verify charge order type.
Electron density per sublattice for the 12-sublattice charge-ordered metal, showing rich-rich-poor sequence.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are checked against paper-reported reference values or structural patterns with appropriate hidden tolerances. The instruction.md will not reveal gold values or tolerances.
